section.description: Other machines' screens this desktop opens through its own bridge. Passwords stay on this desktop.
section.emptyBody: Add a VNC server, your own Guacamole or MeshCentral console, or a RustDesk ID. This desktop resolves a server's address once, pins it, and asks you to confirm it before connecting.
section.unmanagedNote: Only sessions opened here share one controller and are audited. A VNC client that connects to the same server directly bypasses Cognia.
section.noViewOnly: Full control only (cannot be made read-only)
section.deleteBody: Its stored passwords are removed from this desktop and any open session to it ends.
section.descriptionRemote: Other machines' screens {host} opens through its bridge. Passwords stay on {host}.
section.emptyBodyRemote: Add a VNC server that {host} can reach. {host} resolves its address once, pins it, and asks you to confirm before connecting.
section.deleteBodyRemote: Its stored passwords are removed from {host} and any open session to it ends.
section.hostOutdated: {host} cannot broker remote desktops yet. Update it to open them from here.

dialog.description: Cognia connects to the server from this desktop and passes an already-authenticated stream to the viewer.
dialog.noProviders: No remote desktop provider is enabled. Enable the VNC, web console or RustDesk provider plugin in Plugins.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.confirmPrivate: This is a device on your local network ({ip}). Cognia will only ever connect to this address; if the name later points elsewhere you will be asked again.
dialog.confirmPublic: This address is on the internet ({ip}). VNC traffic is not encrypted: anyone on the path can see the screen and what you type.
dialog.consoleUrlHelp: Open the machine in your console, then copy the address of that page. Cognia never stores a console password: you sign in inside the console.
dialog.appHelp: For a self-hosted RustDesk server, enter its address and public key. The password is never stored; RustDesk asks for it.
dialog.confirmConsolePrivate: This console is on your local network ({ip}). It opens in a separate browser view that only this app uses.
dialog.confirmConsolePublic: This console is on the internet ({ip}). It opens over HTTPS in a separate browser view that only this app uses.
dialog.providerManagedNote: The provider signs you in and decides what you may do. Cognia stores no password for it and cannot make it read-only.
dialog.unsupported: This server offers security types {types}. Cognia supports None (1) and VNC password (2) only.
dialog.requiresPassword: The server requires a VNC password.
dialog.noPasswordNeeded: The server accepts connections without a password.
dialog.passwordKeep: Leave blank to keep the stored password
dialog.passwordTruncation: VNC uses only the first 8 characters of a password.
dialog.viewOnlyLabel: The server has a separate view-only password
dialog.viewOnlyDescription: TigerVNC (vncpasswd) and x11vnc (-viewpasswd) enforce it. Without one, this desktop can only be opened with full control.
dialog.noAuthReadOnly: A server without a password cannot be opened read-only.
dialog.savedWithoutPassword: Saved, but the password could not be stored: {message}
dialog.addressChanged: The address changed. Check it again before saving.
dialog.required: Fill in a name, host and port, and check the address.
dialog.descriptionRemote: Cognia connects to the server from {host} and passes an already-authenticated stream to this viewer. The password is sent to {host} once and never shown again.
dialog.confirmPrivateRemote: This is a device on {host}'s local network ({ip}). {host} will only ever connect to this address; if the name later points elsewhere you will be asked again.

viewer.title: Remote desktop
viewer.missingParams: This link does not name a remote desktop.
viewer.notFound: This remote desktop no longer exists.
viewer.providerMissing: The provider for this remote desktop is not installed or enabled.
viewer.takeControlBusy: Someone else is in control. Take over?
viewer.lostControl: Control was taken by another session.
viewer.viewOnlyHint: The server enforces view-only: input is ignored.
viewer.unmanagedNote: Clients that connect to this server directly are not governed by Cognia.
viewer.needsHost: This link names a remote desktop on a desktop's own Host. Open it from that Host in Devices.

console.note: This page is your own console, shown in a separate browser view. Cognia opened it and recorded that; what happens inside it is up to the console.
console.appAsked: RustDesk was asked to connect. Cognia cannot tell whether it did.
console.appBody: This machine is reached with RustDesk, which must be installed on this device. Cognia passes the ID and never the password.
console.outsideBody: This console opens in your browser. Sign in there; Cognia stores no console password.
console.needsControl: Opening this needs control of the Host. Ask its owner for admin access.

errors.adapterUnknown: This provider asks for a protocol Cognia does not support.
errors.bindingCannotBeReadOnly: This server cannot enforce view-only access, so it can only be opened with full control.
errors.bindingChanged: The remote desktop changed while connecting. Try again.
errors.bindingCountInvalid: A remote desktop needs one to eight connections.
errors.bindingHasNoAuthentication: This connection has no password to store.
errors.bindingIdInvalid: The connection id is not valid.
errors.bridgeUnavailable: This desktop could not open its local bridge.
errors.configInvalid: The provider settings are not valid.
errors.connectTimeout: The server did not answer in time.
errors.credentialMissing: No password is stored for this connection. Edit it and enter one.
errors.credentialRequired: The server requires a password. Edit the connection and enter one.
errors.credentialUnavailable: This desktop's secret store is unavailable.
errors.endpointChanged: The name now resolves to a different address. Edit and confirm it again.
errors.endpointForbidden: This address is not allowed (loopback, link-local or cloud metadata).
errors.endpointInvalid: Enter a valid host name or IP address and port.
errors.handshakeTimeout: The server did not finish the handshake in time.
errors.integrationUnavailable: This kind of provider is not available in this version.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on this desktop.
errors.leaseLost: Control was taken by another session.
errors.pageTokenInvalid: The list could not be continued. Reload it.
errors.protocolInvalid: The server sent something that is not VNC.
errors.protocolUnsupported: The server speaks a VNC version Cognia does not support. {detail}
errors.providerDuplicate: A provider with this id is already registered.
errors.providerIdInvalid: The provider id is not valid.
errors.providerPortInvalid: The provider's default port is not valid.
errors.resolveFailed: The host name could not be resolved.
errors.resolveTimeout: Resolving the host name timed out.
errors.securityUnsupported: The server offers only security types Cognia does not support ({detail}). Cognia supports None (1) and VNC password (2).
errors.sessionLimit: Too many remote desktop sessions are open. Close one first.
errors.storageCorrupt: The remote desktop list on this desktop is damaged.
errors.storageInvalid: The remote desktop list on this desktop is not a regular file.
errors.storageLimit: The remote desktop list on this desktop is too large.
errors.storageUnavailable: The remote desktop list on this desktop could not be read or written.
errors.storageVersion: The remote desktop list was written by a newer version of Cognia.
errors.targetLimit: You can save up to 256 remote desktops.
errors.targetNameInvalid: Enter a name of up to 80 characters.
errors.targetNotFound: This remote desktop no longer exists.
errors.ticketExpired: The viewer took too long to connect. Reconnect.
errors.viewerInvalid: The provider's viewer is not valid.
errors.viewerRequiresWebview: Only built-in providers may render their viewer in the app; this one must use a sandboxed view.
errors.adminLeaseRequired: Approve this change on the Host first: it needs a fresh admin approval.
errors.forbidden: This device is not allowed to do that on the Host. An owner can grant it in Devices.
errors.hostConsentRequired: The Host is waiting for approval. Approve code {detail} on the Host, then try again.
errors.hostOutdated: This Host's version cannot broker remote desktops. Update the Host.
errors.hostUnavailable: The Host's remote desktop service is not running.
errors.invalidRequest: The Host refused a malformed request. {detail}
errors.sessionAttached: This session already has a viewer.
errors.transportUnavailable: The current connection to the Host cannot carry a remote desktop. Connect on the same network or enable the direct (WebRTC) connection.
errors.unknownCommand: The Host does not know this remote desktop command.
errors.bindingAccessInvalid: This connection mixes settings of different kinds. Edit it again.
errors.bindingHasNoEndpoint: This connection has no address to check.
errors.bindingNotBridged: This connection opens in its own console or app, not in a Cognia session.
errors.bindingNotLaunchable: This connection opens in a Cognia session, not in a console or app.
errors.consoleProfileUnknown: This provider asks for a console type Cognia does not support.
errors.consoleUnavailable: The console could not be opened on this device.
errors.consoleUrlHasCredentials: Remove the sign-in token or password from the link. Cognia never stores console credentials.
errors.consoleUrlInsecure: A console on the internet must use HTTPS.
errors.consoleUrlInvalid: This isn't a link this console opens a machine with. Copy the address of the machine's page in your console.
errors.launchAppMissing: RustDesk is not installed on this device, or it did not take the link.
errors.launchKeyInvalid: The server key should be the base64 public key of your RustDesk server.
errors.launchPeerInvalid: Enter the RustDesk ID: 6 to 32 letters, digits, "-" or "_".
errors.launchServerInvalid: Enter the ID server as a host name or IP address, with an optional port.
errors.launchUriInvalid: The Host returned a RustDesk link Cognia does not open.
errors.launcherUnknown: This provider asks for an app Cognia cannot launch.
